name: Cabbage Carrot Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup shelled edamame, cooked and cooled
Dressing: 3 tbsp plain low-fat yogurt or soy yogurt, 1 tsp mustard, juice of 1 lemon, black pepper, salt
steps: Cook the edamame for 4 minutes; drain and cool.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, edamame, spring onion and tofu in a large bowl.
Add the dressing and mix well.
note: A crunchy slaw with no sugar or mayonnaise; the edamame lifts the protein.
